message.content:
The quadratic equation is  

\[
x^{2}+2x+3=0 .
\]

Using the quadratic formula \(x=\frac{-b\pm\sqrt{\,b^{2}-4ac\,}}{2a}\):

* Discriminant:  
  \[
  D=b^{2}-4ac=2^{2}-4(1)(3)=4-12=-8 .
  \]

* Roots:  
  \[
  x=\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{-8}}{2}
    =\frac{-2\pm i\sqrt{8}}{2}
    =-1\pm i\sqrt{2}.
  \]

So the two (complex) solutions are  

\[
\boxed{x=-1+i\sqrt{2}}\quad\text{and}\quad\boxed{x=-1-i\sqrt{2}} .
\]
